main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads T test cases containing rectangle dimensions and prints, for each case, the sum of all original rectangle perimeters plus the maximum feasible added perimeter selected by a dynamic-programming scan over the rectangles, capped by the remaining P, formatted to six decimal places." main]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> stdin </REF>: formatted input stream "First line contains T. For each test case, the first line contains N and P, followed by N lines each containing w and h."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> stdout </REF>: formatted output stream "For each test case, prints 'Case #i: total + best_valid' with six decimal places."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Read the number of test cases T from stdin using scanf with a decimal integer format and a trailing whitespace directive; ignore the scanf return value. RESULT T]
            [COMMAND For each test case i from 0 to T-1, run the test case processing loop. RESULT i]
            [COMMAND Within test case i, read integers N and P from stdin using scanf, ignoring the return value; also assign P_orig = P, although P_orig is never read afterward. RESULT N_P_P_orig]
            [COMMAND Within test case i, allocate w, h, and min_add as int arrays of length N, and max_add, best_min, and best_max as double arrays of length N; initialize total to 0. RESULT arrays_total]
            [COMMAND Within test case i, for each j from 0 to N-1, read w[j] and h[j] via scanf, ignoring the return value; compute circ = (w[j] + h[j]) * 2; subtract circ from P; add circ to total; set min_add[j] = 2 * min(w[j], h[j]); set max_add[j] = 2 * sqrt(w[j] * w[j] + h[j] * h[j]). RESULT P_total_min_add_max_add]
            [COMMAND Within test case i, emit debug log 'looking for %d' with the current remaining P using dpr. RESULT debug_log]
            [COMMAND Within test case i, initialize best_valid to 0. RESULT best_valid]
            [COMMAND Within test case i, for each j from 0 to N-1, initialize min1 = 0, max1 = 0, and k1 = -1. RESULT dp_defaults]
            [COMMAND Within the current j, for each k from 0 to j-1, evaluate the short-circuit condition best_min[k] + min_add[j] < P && best_max[k] > max1; if true, select k by setting k1 = k, min1 = best_min[k] truncated to int, and max1 = best_max[k] truncated to int; all best_min[k] and best_max[k] for k < j were assigned by earlier j iterations. RESULT selected_k]
            [COMMAND Within the current j, compute best_min[j] = min1 + min_add[j] and best_max[j] = max1 + max_add[j]; then emit debug log 'cookie %d: using prev %d [%f..%f]' with j, k1, best_min[j], and best_max[j] using dpr. RESULT best_min_j_best_max_j]
            [COMMAND Within the current j, if best_min[j] <= P and best_max[j] > best_valid, update best_valid = best_max[j]. RESULT best_valid_updated]
            [COMMAND After completing the j loop within test case i, if best_valid > P, cap best_valid to P. RESULT best_valid_capped]
            [COMMAND Within test case i, print 'Case #%d: %.6f' to stdout using i + 1 and total + best_valid. RESULT printed_output]
            [COMMAND Within test case i, free max_add, then min_add, then h, then w; leave best_min and best_max unfreed to match the original code. RESULT freed_arrays]
            [COMMAND After all test cases have been processed, call exit(0). RESULT exit_status]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
